periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, slanting inward and downward at approximately a 45-degree angle relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical teardrop shape with a vertical-to-horizontal elongation ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point terminating near the medial nasal region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Wide transverse band covering approximately 35-40% of the visible upper torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide inter-ear separation, estimated at 2.5 to 3 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive yellowish-brown staining present on the fur surrounding the mouth and lower mandible.
